top_signals.title: Trump Says Strait of Hormuz Should Be 'Trump Strait'
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz after himself during remarks on Iran, claiming theUS controls the key trade route and predicting lower oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sadiq Khan urged to end London’s e-bike ‘patchwork’
top_signals.summary: Sadiq Khan has been urged to speed up plans for a London-wide e-bike licence, as Forest warned spiralling council fees and a regulatory “patchwork” risk forcing operators from the capital. In a letter to the mayor seen by City AM, the London-based e-bike operator said delays to Transport for London’s new licensing regime were threatening [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Memories of students killed in World War II live on at Tokyo museum
top_signals.summary: The Wadatsumi no Koe museum holds numerous letters, diaries and other personal effects of young men mobilized to the front lines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Consensys splits MetaMask from institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses
top_signals.summary: The separation is expected to be completed by the end of 2026, with the existing entity rebranding as MetaMask under CEO Joe Lubin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
